title: Normal force at B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the normal force at point B as 30 N using energy conservation and centripetal force.

title: Energy conservation for v_B
description: Important: Applies conservation of mechanical energy to find the block's speed at B as 3 m/s.

title: Work-energy with variable friction
description: Important: Correctly computes the work done by the linearly varying friction force to find the exit speed in part (2) as 1 m/s.

title: Relative motion analysis
description: Important: Sets up the relative displacement equation between block and flatcar equaling the car length for part (3).

title: Projectile motion time
description: Important: Correctly calculates the time of fall from height h using t = sqrt(2h/g).

title: Final landing distance
description: Essential: Determines the horizontal landing distance relative to the flatcar's end as 0.2 m in part (3).

title: Sign error in relative velocity
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign for relative velocity in the projectile distance calculation (should be v_block - v_car).

title: Forgetting Newton's third law
description: Pitfall: Fails to state that the normal force on the track equals the normal force on the block (action-reaction).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Shows unit analysis for key equations (e.g., energy, force) to verify dimensional consistency.
